name: POST /api/tenants/:tenant_id/bus - Create BU
description: Creates a business unit under :tenant_id. name and kind are required; parent_bu_id is optional and nests the BU inside another BU. Edge cases: kind is free text here — only presence is checked, so an unsupported kind is rejected by the DB (surfacing as 500) rather than by a 400; an unknown :tenant_id or a parent_bu_id that does not exist is a foreign-key violation mapped to 400 ValidationError, NOT 404; a duplicate BU name within the tenant maps to 409 Conflict where a unique constraint exists; the handler does not guard against a parent_bu_id belonging to a different tenant, nor against creating a cycle in the BU tree.

errorCases.when: Authorization header absent or not in 'Bearer <jwt>' form (requireAuth preHandler)
JWT signature invalid, malformed, or exp has elapsed

errorCases.message: name is required / kind is required
errorCases.when: validateCreateBu fails; all failures are returned together in details[]
:tenant_id or parent_bu_id references a row that does not exist

errorCases.message: <pg error: duplicate key value violates unique constraint ...>
errorCases.when: a BU unique constraint (e.g. name within the tenant) is violated
the service throws a not-found error while resolving the tenant or parent BU
Unexpected service/DB failure (connection loss, or a constraint the handler does not map)
